summary: The Bun Postgres contract passed after node-pg set search_path on their shared Mockingbird wire database, but fails alone with current_schema() = public instead of <namespace>_test_scope. The isolated server now exposes the startup failure. Mockingbird Postgres 3.0.2's wire handler ignores startup schema options; the existing options=-c search_path URL and Bun's supported connection.search_path both reproduce it. Upstream blocker: https://github.com/crvouga/mockingbird/issues/317 (open). No production driver workaround or gate bypass is applied.
